articles.title: What a decision in Washington changes at home
articles.dek: A sample frame for following federal policy through to everyday life.
articles.summary: This placeholder shows how a politics story can separate the decision itself from arguments about its effects. A finished article will link to primary records and independent reporting, and will flag important unknowns rather than filling them with guesses.
articles.whyItMatters: The goal is to explain consequences without asking readers to adopt a party’s framing.

articles.title: The local angle can change the national story
articles.dek: A placeholder for state, local, and community perspectives.
articles.summary: National politics is not experienced uniformly. A daily brief can surface a local or regional view alongside national coverage, while keeping the source, date, and scope of each claim visible.
articles.whyItMatters: A wider lens makes it easier to understand who is missing from a headline.
